label: Free 2.0
title: Bigger sites, more languages, fewer files to worry about
lede: Cosine 2.0 makes the MIT package ready for very large docs: a smaller index format, shards, and 4-bit vectors. It also finds words in Chinese, Japanese and Thai, and ships integrations for Astro (Starlight), Docusaurus and VitePress.

items.title: Shards for large sites
items.text: Split the index into several files that the browser loads in parallel. Results rank exactly like one file, and unchanged shards keep their name so your CDN can cache them.

items.title: Search in Chinese, Japanese and Thai
items.text: Cosine 2 splits scripts without spaces into words with Intl.Segmenter, so a search for a short word finds longer phrases and highlights it.
items.code: cosine search public/cosine 東京 --mode lexical --limit 1
items.output:
1. Tokyo  (lexical)
   /tokyo
   東京 東京タワーは東京の有名な観光地です。

items.title: 4-bit vectors
items.text: Store each vector value in 4 bits. The vector file is half the size, at a small cost in ranking quality.

items.title: Docusaurus, Astro and VitePress integrations
items.text: Add the plugin and the index is built with your site. The same package exports /astro and /vitepress.

note: Real output comes from @sweberdev/cosine 2.0.0 from npm, using a keyword-only build. The 4-bit vectors and the integrations are shown from the docs.
